# Kay Joy Flowers

> Author and educator Kay Joy Flowers (born in Cape Town, South Africa; lives in New Zealand; 35+ years in education) writes books and embodied practices for women who know there's more to them: self-trust, nervous-system steadiness and personal sovereignty. Her body of work is called A Living Cosmology of Remembrance. Her flagship book is Fearlessly Unfuckwithable.

## Books and offers

- [Fearlessly Unfuckwithable](https://kayjoyflowers.online/fearlessly-unfuckwithable.html): The flagship book (digital, US$33) and the Sovereignty Bundle (US$77): the book, the 7-Day Survival to Sovereignty Reset and Journal, the FU Somatic Arsenal (ten body-first practices) and the Unfuckwithable Companion.
- [Genius Insight energetic scans](https://kayjoyflowers.online/genius-insight.html): Remote energetic scans by distance from a photo and voice recording. One-off scan US$100, or a weekly scan membership at US$120 a month. Complementary wellness only, not medical care.
- [The Library](https://kayjoyflowers.online/library.html): The wider catalogue, including Medicine Woman, Energetic Alchemist, Jailbreak, Art, the Language of the Soul, Education, A New Way and The Journey to Wholeness (most coming soon).
